info.name: Daggerheart Core API Collection
info.description:
Comprehensive Postman Collection for the Daggerheart TTRPG Core API (142 endpoints). Includes authentication, user management, character sheets, campaigns, and all game content endpoints.

Authentication uses HTTP-only cookies. After login, the AUTH_TOKEN cookie is automatically set and used for subsequent requests.

**Setup:**
1. Set baseUrl variable to http://localhost:8080
2. Register or login to get AUTH_TOKEN cookie
3. Cookie automatically included in subsequent requests

item.name: Authentication
item.description: User authentication endpoints including registration, login, and logout. Login and logout require authentication.

body.raw:
{
  "username": "aragorn_ranger",
  "email": "aragorn@gondor.com",
  "password": "Strider123!",
  "timezone": "America/New_York",
  "avatarUrl": "https://api.dicebear.com/7.x/avatars/svg?seed=aragorn"
}

request.description: Register a new user account. Password must be at least 8 characters with uppercase, lowercase, digit, and special character.
Login with username/email and password. Sets AUTH_TOKEN cookie for subsequent requests.
Logout current user and clear AUTH_TOKEN cookie. Requires authentication.

item.name: User Management
item.description: User profile and account management endpoints. All require authentication.

request.description: Get the current authenticated user's profile.
Get a user's profile by ID.
Update the current user's profile. Partial updates supported.
Change the current user's password. Invalidates all existing tokens.
Soft delete the current user's account. Invalidates all tokens.

item.name: Admin
item.description: Administrative endpoints for user management and audit logs. Requires ADMIN/OWNER roles.

request.description: Get all login attempts. Requires ADMIN or OWNER role.
Get login history for a specific user. Requires ADMIN or OWNER role.
Get login history by IP address. Requires ADMIN or OWNER role.
Ban a user. Requires MODERATOR, ADMIN, or OWNER role.
Unban a user. Requires MODERATOR, ADMIN, or OWNER role.
Change a user's role. Requires OWNER role. Valid roles: USER, MODERATOR, ADMIN, OWNER.

item.name: Companions
item.description: Companion character management. Companions belong to character sheets.

request.description: List companions. Filter by characterSheetId. Expand: characterSheet, experiences.
Get companion by ID. Expand: characterSheet, experiences.

body.raw:
{
  "characterSheetId": {{characterSheetId}},
  "name": "Shadow",
  "description": "A loyal wolf companion",
  "hitPointMax": 6,
  "hitPointMarked": 0,
  "stressMax": 3,
  "stressMarked": 0
}

request.description: Create a new companion for a character sheet.
Update companion. Partial updates supported.
Delete companion (hard delete).

item.name: Experiences
item.description: Experience management for characters and companions.

request.description: List experiences. Filter by characterSheetId or companionId.
Get experience by ID.
Create experience for character or companion. Include characterSheetId OR companionId.
Update experience. Partial updates supported.
Delete experience (hard delete).

item.name: Campaigns
item.description: Campaign management for group play. GMs can manage players and character sheets.

request.description: List campaigns (MODERATOR+ only). Filters: creatorId, name. Expand: creator, gameMasters, players, pendingCharacterSheets, playerCharacters, nonPlayerCharacters, all.
Get campaign by ID. Only participants or moderators can view.
Create a new campaign. Creator automatically becomes a game master.
Update campaign. Only creator or moderators can update.
Soft delete campaign. Only creator or moderators can delete.
Add user as game master. Only creator or moderators can add GMs.
Remove game master. Cannot remove creator.
Add player to campaign. Requires GM access.
Remove player from campaign. Requires GM access.
Submit character sheet for GM approval. Must be sheet owner and campaign player.
Approve pending character sheet. Requires GM access. Moves to player characters.
Reject pending character sheet. Requires GM access.
Add character as NPC. Requires GM access.
Remove character sheet from campaign. Requires GM access.

request.description: List adversaries. Filters: expansionId, tier (1-4), adversaryType, isOfficial, name. Expand: expansion, creator, originalAdversary, experiences, features.
Get adversary by ID. Expand: expansion, creator, originalAdversary, experiences, features.

request.description: Batch create adversaries. Requires MODERATOR+ role. Returns 207 Multi-Status on partial failure.
Update adversary. Creator or MODERATOR+ can update non-official. OWNER only for official.

request.description: List encounters. Filters: campaignId, tier, isOfficial, name. Expand: creator, campaign, originalEncounter, adversaryDetails.

Create a new encounter. User becomes the creator.
Create a private copy of an encounter. Linked via originalEncounterId.
Update encounter. Creator or MODERATOR+ can update non-official. OWNER only for official.
Soft delete encounter. Creator or MODERATOR+ can delete non-official. OWNER only for official.
Restore soft-deleted encounter. Requires ADMIN or OWNER role.
Add an adversary to the encounter. Creates an encounter adversary instance.
Remove an adversary instance from the encounter.
